basis: Explicit collection and addressee formulas, complete parental instructions, complete personified-Wisdom speeches, proverb-cluster function, numerical formulas, royal instruction, and alphabetic-poem closure. Canonical relations and Hebrew or translation observations are evidence only.
proposal_bias: Prefer the larger coherent instruction, speech, named collection, functional aphorism cluster, numerical saying, or poem. Keep disputed smaller seams LOW and preserve exact larger alternatives.

chunks.form: anthology superscription and programmatic prologue
chunks.marker: Purpose infinitives and audience statements culminate in the fear/knowledge maxim before the first parental vocative.
chunks.rejection: Do not infer authorship, chronology, or theology from the superscription; 1:8 opens a new direct address.
chunks.risk: Isolating 1:7 as a famous doctrinal slogan or treating the title as an authorship ruling.
chunks.hold: none; form seam only

chunks.form: parental instruction against the violent gain-seeking band
chunks.marker: My-son address, quoted enticement, prohibition, motive, and bird/net plus blood-for-gain closure.
chunks.rejection: The quotation and consequence belong together; 1:20 changes to Wisdom's public voice.
chunks.risk: Extracting 1:8-9 or a single warning from the complete instruction.
chunks.hold: none

chunks.form: personified Wisdom public warning speech
chunks.marker: Wisdom cries in public, addresses refusers, and closes with the hearer dwelling securely.
chunks.rejection: Do not identify Wisdom ontologically or let later canonical reception dictate the seam.
chunks.risk: Personification-theology smuggling and detaching invitation from refusal consequences.
chunks.hold: defer ontology, speaker metaphysics, and canonical identity

chunks.form: conditional parental instruction on seeking wisdom and deliverance
chunks.marker: My-son conditional protasis governs the chapter; purpose/result clauses lead through two deliverances to land/way closure.
chunks.rejection: The two deliverance movements remain under one opening condition; the chapter coincidence is supported by a complete protasis-result form.
chunks.risk: Treating gendered personifications or strange-woman vocabulary as ontology or social-theological rulings.
chunks.hold: defer Hebrew gender, translation, and ethical-system claims

chunks.form: parental instruction on teaching, trust, honor, and discipline
chunks.marker: My-son address with paired commands and motives closes in a parental-discipline comparison.
chunks.rejection: Famous verses 3:5-6 remain inside the command-motive chain.
chunks.risk: Proof-texting trust, wealth, health, or discipline as an automatic universal formula.
chunks.hold: defer lexical and theological generalization

chunks.form: wisdom beatitude, value catalogue, and creation testimony
chunks.marker: Happy formula opens; comparative value chain culminates in YHWH-by-wisdom creation language.
chunks.rejection: Creation language does not authorize personification ontology; the value and creation movements remain a compact hymn-like unit.
chunks.risk: Using canonical echoes to identify Wisdom, or splitting 3:18/19 to serve a theological system.
chunks.hold: defer ontology, dependence, and reception claims

chunks.form: parental instruction on sound wisdom, fearless conduct, and neighbor relations
chunks.marker: My-son resumption; safeguards and prohibitions lead to a wicked/righteous household contrast closure.
chunks.rejection: The conduct list functions as one instruction; individual neighbor maxims are not isolated.
chunks.risk: Atomizing commands or universalizing prosperity/security language without the instruction frame.
chunks.hold: none beyond ordinary wisdom-form caution

chunks.form: intergenerational parental instruction to acquire wisdom
chunks.marker: Plural sons address moves to remembered paternal teaching and closes with Wisdom's honor/crown promise.
chunks.rejection: The remembered father voice remains inside the present instruction rather than becoming an authorship genealogy.
chunks.risk: Turning the family frame into a historical attribution or isolating the crown promise.
chunks.hold: defer historical speaker identity

chunks.form: two-path parental instruction
chunks.marker: My-son address, hear-and-walk imperative, wicked-path prohibition, and light/dark path contrast.
chunks.rejection: The paired paths form one contrast; 4:20 resumes with a new my-son appeal and body-part catalogue.
chunks.risk: Extracting 4:18 as a decontextualized progress promise.
chunks.hold: none

chunks.form: parental body-and-path guarding instruction
chunks.marker: My-son address organizes ear, eyes, heart, mouth, gaze, feet, and turning commands into a complete embodied exhortation.
chunks.rejection: Do not isolate 4:23; the heart command belongs to the surrounding body/path sequence.
chunks.risk: Famous-verse isolation and root-based anthropology.
chunks.hold: none

chunks.form: parental warning and marital-fidelity instruction
chunks.marker: My-son wisdom appeal, strange-woman warning, consequence speech, cistern imagery, and final way/discipline evaluation.
chunks.rejection: The warning and positive fidelity counsel answer each other; gendered terms do not authorize an ontology or blanket social judgment.
chunks.risk: Proof-texting sexuality, gender, or retribution and settling difficult Hebrew labels by the seam.
chunks.hold: defer gendered terminology, translation, and ethical-system claims

chunks.form: surety rescue instruction
chunks.marker: My-son conditional debt/surety case and urgent self-deliverance commands close with gazelle/bird imagery.
chunks.rejection: The compact conditional case is complete before the sluggard address.
chunks.risk: Universalizing an ancient surety case into exhaustive economic doctrine.
chunks.hold: none

chunks.form: ant-and-sluggard observation with refrain
chunks.marker: Direct sluggard address, ant observation, sleep-folded-hands refrain, and poverty attack closure.
chunks.rejection: The ant lesson is a complete observation; it is not merged merely because the next unit is also a vice portrait.
chunks.risk: Flattening wisdom observation into a universal causal guarantee.
chunks.hold: none

chunks.form: troublemaker body catalogue and six/seven abominations list
chunks.marker: Worthless-person body-part catalogue leads into the numerical six/seven list, joined by shared body and discord motifs.
chunks.rejection: The exact internal split is plausible, so the larger shared-function unit is retained LOW.
chunks.risk: Atomizing the seven items or treating the numerical form as an exhaustive vice taxonomy.
chunks.hold: defer whether 6:16 begins a separate numerical saying

chunks.form: parental adultery warning with command, desire, and jealous-husband consequences
chunks.marker: My-son parental-command frame resumes; lamp/command explanation, desire warning, fire analogy, and husband/restitution closure.
chunks.rejection: The instruction is complete before the new my-son scenario in chapter 7; no famous maxim is isolated.
chunks.risk: Gender stereotyping, legal harmonization, or sexual-ethics system selection from compressed sayings.
chunks.hold: defer translation and legal-cultural claims

chunks.form: parental command plus narrated seduction warning
chunks.marker: My-son command opens; first-person window observation narrates the encounter; final sons-address and death-way warning close.
chunks.rejection: Frame, narrative example, and concluding appeal belong together despite their internal movements.
chunks.risk: Treating the narrated woman as an ontology of women or extracting sensual details from the warning frame.
chunks.hold: defer gender, historical, and reception claims

chunks.form: personified Wisdom's public self-presentation and invitation
chunks.marker: Rhetorical call opens, direct speech spans truth/value/royal/creation claims, and blessed-hearer versus rejecting-self contrast closes.
chunks.rejection: The complete speech is retained; 8:22-31 is not isolated to decide translation, ontology, Christology, creation order, or dependence.
chunks.risk: Maximum personified-Wisdom theology smuggling and disputed Hebrew/translation pressure in 8:22-31.
chunks.hold: defer every ontology, preferred translation, and canonical-identification ruling

chunks.form: Wisdom's house, feast, messenger, and invitation tableau
chunks.marker: Wisdom builds and prepares, sends maidens, quotes an invitation, and closes with life/understanding imperative.
chunks.rejection: Keep preparation and invitation together; later banquet imagery is relation evidence only.
chunks.risk: Letting later canonical banquet reuse dictate the seam or theology.
chunks.hold: defer intertext/dependence claims

chunks.form: wise/scoffer instruction and personal consequence interlude
chunks.marker: Instruction on correction contrasts scoffer and wise, returns to fear/wisdom, and closes with individual consequence.
chunks.rejection: This compact didactic interlude separates the two female banquet tableaux but its exact editorial function remains uncertain.
chunks.risk: Using the seam to assert redaction history or a doctrinal definition of fear.
chunks.hold: defer composition and editorial-history inference

chunks.form: Folly's rival banquet tableau
chunks.marker: Woman Folly sits, calls passersby, repeats the invitation formula, and closes with hidden dead/Sheol consequence.
chunks.rejection: The rival invitation is kept complete and paired conceptually, not merged structurally, with Wisdom's banquet.
chunks.risk: Turning personification into ontology or isolating stolen-water imagery.
chunks.hold: none beyond personification non-authority

chunks.form: first broad movement of the Solomonic aphorism collection dominated by antithetic sayings
chunks.marker: 10:1 explicit collection formula; dense antithetic bicola and recurring righteous/wicked, speech, labor, wealth, and discipline networks persist through 15:33.
chunks.rejection: No verse-pair atomization or chapter fallback; the proposed macro-seam before 16:1 is a LOW formal-density shift, not a claim of author, date, or fixed redaction layer.
chunks.risk: Overconfident thematic clustering, famous-proverb isolation, and hiding the named collection parent.
chunks.hold: defer exact internal clusters; preserve Prov.10.1-Prov.22.16 parent

chunks.form: second broad movement of the Solomonic aphorism collection with synthetic, royal, social, and prudential chains
chunks.marker: A concentration of YHWH/human planning sayings at 16:1 opens a changed rhetorical texture; catchword and court/social clusters continue to the boundary before 22:17.
chunks.rejection: The macro-unit avoids pretending every topic change is a seam; 22:17 supplies the explicit next collection/addressee opening.
chunks.risk: Treating the 15:33/16:1 transition as certain, flattening Hebrew parallelism, or extracting famous sayings.
chunks.hold: defer exact 15:33/16:1 status and all smaller cluster boundaries

chunks.form: sayings-of-the-wise addressee preface and commission
chunks.marker: Incline-your-ear formula, heart/lips purpose clauses, trust motive, and thirty-sayings/true-words commission.
chunks.rejection: The preface stays attached to the collection concept but is a distinct commissioning frame before case admonitions.
chunks.risk: Settling the disputed force/numbering of 'thirty' or asserting literary dependence on external wisdom texts.
chunks.hold: defer numbering, translation, and ANE-dependence claims

chunks.form: wise admonition chain on poor, anger, surety, boundary, and skilled service
chunks.marker: Repeated negative commands with motives move from vulnerable-neighbor conduct to court-ready skill.
chunks.rejection: The exact cluster boundary is catchword/form based and remains LOW; individual admonitions are not atomized.
chunks.risk: Inventing a firm thematic collection or turning ancient boundary/surety cases into exhaustive law.
chunks.hold: defer internal saying count and cluster seam

chunks.form: court, wealth, miser, speech, boundary, and orphan admonition chain
chunks.marker: Table/ruler scenario opens; escalating appetite/wealth/host/boundary warnings close with the strong-redeemer motive.
chunks.rejection: The chain is retained as a larger prudential/social unit; the chapter start itself has no authority.
chunks.risk: Overconfident thematic grouping and translation decisions in compressed sayings.
chunks.hold: defer exact internal division and cultural reconstruction

chunks.form: discipline, heart, envy, appetite, and parental joy instruction
chunks.marker: Apply-heart command, child-discipline unit, my-son heart appeal, envy warning, appetite warning, and parent-joy closure.
chunks.rejection: The repeated son/heart/parent vocabulary supports a larger instruction; no discipline verse is isolated.
chunks.risk: Using discipline language to authorize harm, or extracting promise and joy sayings from their wisdom context.
chunks.hold: defer ethical application, Hebrew terms, and exact saying count

chunks.form: my-son warning sequence against seduction, intoxication, and envy of violent people
chunks.marker: Give-me-your-heart appeal, pit imagery, extended drunkard address, and cross-chapter envy/violent-company prohibition.
chunks.rejection: The unit crosses the chapter seam because direct son-address warnings continue; the intoxication tableau is not detached.
chunks.risk: Gender stereotyping, moral proof-texting, and chapter-driven splitting.
chunks.hold: defer whether 24:1-2 closes this chain or opens the next

chunks.form: wisdom-strength and rescue-responsibility admonition chain
chunks.marker: Wisdom builds a house, wise strength/counsel sayings follow, then rescue and heart-weighing accountability close the sequence.
chunks.rejection: Catchword/function supports the larger unit but cannot prove a fixed editorial cluster.
chunks.risk: Turning rescue/accountability sayings into a total political or soteriological system.
chunks.hold: defer exact cluster seam and canonical-reuse claims

chunks.form: honey-wisdom analogy and warnings concerning righteous fall, enemies, evildoers, and rulers
chunks.marker: My-son honey analogy opens; future-hope motive, fall/rejoicing warnings, and repeated do-not-fret/fear formulas close with sudden ruin.
chunks.rejection: The closing warnings remain within the Sayings of the Wise parent; no verse is extracted to settle political theology.
chunks.risk: Harmonizing ethical tensions or deriving political obedience doctrine from a chunk seam.
chunks.hold: defer ethical harmonization and ruler-language theology

chunks.form: 'also these are sayings of the wise' subcollection with judgment counsel and sluggard-field observation
chunks.marker: Explicit secondary collection formula opens; court speech/adjudication sayings lead to the first-person field observation and repeated poverty closure.
chunks.rejection: The explicit subcollection parent is preferred over splitting its two evident movements; 25:1 opens the next named collection.
chunks.risk: Ignoring the subcollection formula or atomizing the field vignette.
chunks.hold: preserve two internal movements as exact alternatives

chunks.form: Hezekiah-copying superscription plus royal-court counsel
chunks.marker: Explicit copied-Solomon collection formula opens; king/glory/search and court-placement sayings form the initial royal sequence.
chunks.rejection: The superscription is not isolated and does not settle authorship, historicity, dating, or textual history.
chunks.risk: Treating copying metadata as authorship authority or letting Gospel reuse of seat imagery dictate the seam.
chunks.hold: defer authorship, chronology, history, and canonical-reuse claims

chunks.form: neighbor-conflict, speech, restraint, and self-mastery proverb cluster
chunks.marker: Dispute/neighbor counsel leads through apt speech, messenger, enemy, weather, and restraint analogies to the wall/self-control closure.
chunks.rejection: The functional cluster is LOW; famous enemy-feeding verses and individual similes stay contextualized.
chunks.risk: Overstating a thematic chain or using later canonical quotation to isolate 25:21-22.
chunks.hold: defer exact internal clusters and intertext/dependence direction

chunks.form: fool-saying catalogue
chunks.marker: Repeated fool terminology governs honor, rod, answer/non-answer, messenger, legs, proverb, thorn, archer, dog, and self-wise observations.
chunks.rejection: The catalogue is preserved despite tensions such as 26:4-5; no harmonizing split is imposed.
chunks.risk: Isolating contradictory-looking maxims to force harmonization or an ethical rule.
chunks.hold: defer application/harmonization of 26:4-5

chunks.form: sluggard-saying miniature catalogue
chunks.marker: Four consecutive sluggard sayings move from imagined lion through door/bed/dish to self-wise closure.
chunks.rejection: Repetition supplies a strong local cluster; sayings are not atomized.
chunks.risk: Universalizing caricature into social classification.
chunks.hold: none

chunks.form: meddling, deception, quarrel, gossip, hatred, and flattering-speech cluster
chunks.marker: Conflict-entry warning leads through madman/joke analogy, wood/fire and gossip images, and deceptive speech consequences.
chunks.rejection: The shared conflict/speech function supports the cluster but its precise start/end remains LOW.
chunks.risk: Treating catchwords as proof of fixed redaction or extracting gossip metaphors as standalone doctrine.
chunks.hold: defer exact cluster boundary

chunks.form: boasting, anger, rebuke, friendship, and neighbor counsel cluster
chunks.marker: Tomorrow-boast warning moves through anger/jealousy, faithful wounds, desire, and friend/neighbor counsel.
chunks.rejection: Friendship sayings remain in a mixed prudential chain; chapter number is not the deciding marker.
chunks.risk: Overconfident topic labeling and famous-verse isolation.
chunks.hold: defer exact opening and internal divisions

chunks.form: prudence, surety, relational friction, praise, and testing cluster
chunks.marker: My-son wisdom appeal opens; repeated prudential cases culminate in crucible/furnace praise-testing and folly-pounding closure.
chunks.rejection: The mixed cluster is provisional; 27:23 begins a sustained flock-economy imperative sequence.
chunks.risk: Inventing unity from proximity or isolating iron-sharpens-iron as a complete theory of community.
chunks.hold: defer internal clusters and 27:17 application

chunks.form: flock stewardship and household-provision instruction
chunks.marker: Know-your-flocks imperative governs crown/grass/hay/lamb/goat/milk sequence to household provision closure.
chunks.rejection: The sustained agrarian register and imperative support an independent unit without turning it into universal economic policy.
chunks.risk: Anachronistic economic system building or extracting one labor maxim.
chunks.hold: none

chunks.form: law, justice, wealth, rulers, confession, and integrity proverb network
chunks.marker: Righteous/wicked and governance contrasts open; repeated law, poor/rich, oppression, confession, fear, and integrity terms continue to the blameless/crooked closure.
chunks.rejection: The broad network is LOW and does not authorize a single political-economic theology.
chunks.risk: Overconfident thematic clustering, wealth/retribution proof-texting, and law/covenant harmonization.
chunks.hold: defer exact cluster seam and ethical/political synthesis

chunks.form: labor, wealth, partiality, discipline, governance, and justice cross-chapter cluster
chunks.marker: Labor/wealth sequence continues into appetite, rebuke, greed, wicked/righteous public order, and king/poor justice sayings through 29:14.
chunks.rejection: The cross-chapter unit prevents automatic chapter fallback but is explicitly LOW because several competing cluster seams are credible.
chunks.risk: Manufactured cross-chapter unity, political proof-texting, and thematic certainty unsupported by explicit formulas.
chunks.hold: defer entire clustering decision; preserve named-collection parent

chunks.form: discipline, governance, speech, anger, service, and human-versus-YHWH fear collection closure
chunks.marker: Child-discipline sequence leads through wicked/righteous governance, speech/anger/service warnings, and closes with fear-of-man/YHWH trust plus just/unjust mutual abhorrence.
chunks.rejection: The closing cluster remains LOW; 30:1 supplies the next explicit speaker/title formula.
chunks.risk: Discipline harm, political or theological system selection, and isolating 29:25.
chunks.hold: defer exact start and ethical application

chunks.form: Agur superscription, confession, divine-word sayings, and twofold petition
chunks.marker: Agur title/speech formula opens; difficult addressee wording, human-limitation questions, tested-word warning, and numbered two-request prayer close at daily-bread sufficiency.
chunks.rejection: The confession and petition stay together as the first Agur discourse movement; no name, translation, or canonical identity is settled.
chunks.risk: Agur/Ithiel/Ucal translation, proper-name segmentation, Christological reuse, and authorship smuggling.
chunks.hold: defer 30:1 translation, names, speaker/addressee, and 30:4 canonical identification

chunks.form: social warning and insatiable-generation catalogue culminating in filial-derision judgment
chunks.marker: Servant-slander warning leads to four repeated 'generation' descriptions, leech appetite formula, and eye/parent consequence.
chunks.rejection: The transition at 30:15 is textually/formally difficult; the larger sequence is retained LOW rather than forcing a saying count.
chunks.risk: Miscounting numerical formulas, joining/splitting the leech daughters wrongly, or moral taxonomy smuggling.
chunks.hold: defer 30:15 segmentation and exact numerical-saying relations

chunks.form: three/four wondrous ways numerical saying with adulteress coda
chunks.marker: Three/four formula governs four 'ways'; 30:20 adds an explicitly analogical 'so is the way' coda.
chunks.rejection: Keep the disputed coda with its lexical way-link while preserving the smaller numerical saying as an exact alternative.
chunks.risk: Gendered moralizing and overconfident attachment of 30:20.
chunks.hold: defer whether 30:20 is integral coda or adjacent saying

chunks.form: three/four unbearable social reversals numerical saying
chunks.marker: Three/four formula enumerates four social reversals and closes after the fourth.
chunks.rejection: The complete numerical form is retained; social terms do not authorize a hierarchy or cultural reconstruction.
chunks.risk: Turning observations into timeless social ontology.
chunks.hold: none beyond cultural-context caution

chunks.form: four small-but-wise creatures numerical catalogue
chunks.marker: Four-on-earth formula and four parallel creature observations close with the lizard in palaces.
chunks.rejection: All four examples remain together; animal identification variants do not govern the boundary.
chunks.risk: Preferred zoological translation or allegorical theology.
chunks.hold: defer creature identification and translation

chunks.form: three/four stately walkers numerical catalogue
chunks.marker: Three/four formula enumerates four stately movers and closes after the king/army image.
chunks.rejection: The complete list is retained; disputed animal and king wording remains evidence-only.
chunks.risk: Zoological or political interpretation controlling translation or seam.
chunks.hold: defer creature and royal-phrase translation

chunks.form: closing restraint admonition with pressure/churning triad
chunks.marker: Conditional self-exaltation/planning command leads to three repeated pressing/churning results and strife closure.
chunks.rejection: The closing admonition is distinct from the preceding numerical catalogue but remains within the Agur collection parent.
chunks.risk: Detaching the compact imagery into lexical speculation.
chunks.hold: none

chunks.form: Lemuel superscription and maternal royal instruction
chunks.marker: Lemuel title and 'which his mother taught him' frame; maternal address, warnings, and repeated open-your-mouth justice charge close at 31:9.
chunks.rejection: Title stays with instruction; names, oracle wording, authorship, historicity, and translation are not decided.
chunks.risk: Lemuel/name/oracle translation, authorship assumptions, alcohol or kingship doctrine, and political proof-texting.
chunks.hold: defer 31:1 translation, identity, historicity, and authorship

chunks.form: alphabetic capable/worthy-wife poem
chunks.marker: New woman-question opening; Hebrew alphabetic sequence sustains the poem; household, wisdom, fear, praise, and works-at-gates evaluation close the book.
chunks.rejection: The alphabetic poem remains whole; famous verses, business/domestic themes, and closing praise are not extracted.
chunks.risk: Fragmenting the acrostic, selecting one gender ideology, or using translation choices to define womanhood theology.
chunks.hold: defer lexical, gender-role, historical, and theological system claims

premortem_holds.risk: Famous-verse isolation, chapter fallback, or treating personified Wisdom as an ontological/theological conclusion.
premortem_holds.appeal: Retain complete parental instructions and complete Wisdom/Folly speeches; route Hebrew gender, personification, 8:22-31 translation, and canonical reception to qualified review.

premortem_holds.risk: One-couplet atomization or overconfident thematic clusters inside the first Solomonic collection.
premortem_holds.appeal: Retain the named collection as an exact parent; treat the 15:33/16:1 macro-seam and every smaller cluster as LOW/deferred.

premortem_holds.risk: Forcing a thirty-saying enumeration, external dependence theory, or English chapter structure onto the Sayings of the Wise.
premortem_holds.appeal: Keep explicit preface and larger admonition chains; defer numbering, translation, ANE comparison, and composition history.

premortem_holds.risk: Ignoring the 'also these' collection formula or splitting solely at the field vignette.
premortem_holds.appeal: Preserve the whole secondary subcollection and its two exact internal alternatives.

premortem_holds.risk: Treating Hezekiah-copying metadata as authorship/history authority or inventing topic clusters from isolated catchwords.
premortem_holds.appeal: Preserve the named collection as exact parent; all proposed subclusters except the strongest repeated catalogues remain LOW.

premortem_holds.risk: Selecting translations for Agur/Ithiel/Ucal, miscounting three/four sayings, or letting animal/name identification drive seams.
premortem_holds.appeal: Keep numerical formulas intact, preserve disputed adjacent attachments, and route names, syntax, numbering, and zoology to Hebrew/textual specialists.

premortem_holds.risk: Settling Lemuel identity, authorship, oracle translation, royal ethics, or political theology from the title/instruction frame.
premortem_holds.appeal: Keep the maternal royal instruction complete and LOW; defer all identity, history, translation, and theology claims.

premortem_holds.risk: Fragmenting the alphabetic poem or using its chunk structure to impose one gender-role or economic theology.
premortem_holds.appeal: Keep all twenty-two alphabetic lines in one poem; route lexical, social-historical, reception, and theological questions externally.
